acceptance_evidence.reference: Six isolated integration tests prove mutation-free install/uninstall previews; idempotent Codex and Claude installs; preservation of unrelated TOML, JSON, and evidence sentinels; dated recoverable backups; fail-closed malformed-marker handling; real connector initialization, tool discovery, and evidence query over a private Unix socket; real session register/end traffic; actionable unavailable-app diagnostics; and uninstall limited to the owned disk_steward entry and plugin. The Codex plugin and evidence skill pass their official structural validators.

discovered_risks: Codex and Claude may evolve their local configuration schemas; installer ownership markers and JSON key isolation make upgrades reversible, while diagnostics expose discovery failures.
Task registration improves correlation but cannot prove individual file writes; the integration skill and session result preserve that limitation.
The adapters depend only on macOS system zsh and Swift; the shipped app package must include or resolve the connector executable path selected during installation.
Uninstall moves owned plugin/config state into a dated backup rather than destroying it, so users may later choose when to remove those small backups.

evidence: Every changed file is within TASK-312's Package.swift, Integrations, Scripts/Integration, Tests/IntegrationInstallTests, or docs/integrations scope.

The validated disk-steward plugin includes a valid manifest, a stdio MCP companion, and a validated narrow skill. The installer emits one owned TOML block with the exact connector and preserves unrelated configuration through install, repeat upgrade, and uninstall.

The Swift JSON merger creates or updates only mcpServers.disk_steward, retains unrelated root keys and MCP servers, writes atomically with mode 0600, and removes only the owned server during uninstall.

The standalone adapter verifies current-user ownership, socket type, and private mode before sending bounded registration/end envelopes. A real socket test captured registration and end results without persisted credentials.

An installed connector completed initialize, tools/list, and get_storage_summary against a private fixture service; the transcript included the read-only catalog and fixture evidence and no delete tool.

Dry runs create no configuration roots. Malformed Codex ownership markers fail closed before plugin/config replacement. Upgrades and uninstalls retain dated backups, and evidence sentinels remain byte-identical.

The required doctor dry run passed. Concrete diagnostics verify discovery, connector self-check, socket owner/mode, and provide an explicit open-app/enable-monitoring recovery path when unavailable without modifying evidence.
Six focused integration tests, all 82 repository tests, swift build, git diff --check, plugin validation, and skill validation passed.
